rationale: The plan correctly recognizes log2(TPM+1) values are not counts, rules out DESeq2/edgeR/voom, and fits limma-trend (lmFit, eBayes trend=TRUE, robust=TRUE) with control as explicit reference and a named treated-vs-control contrast, BH at 0.05 via topTable and no post hoc thresholds. It performs a value-range check (fractional, non-integer, log scale) and explicitly forbids re-transformation and re-normalization; QC (PCA/MDS, distance heatmap, detected-gene counts) precedes modeling, though the outlier handling is a flag rather than a stated policy, and the range check appears in Step 2 rather than before QC. The filter is label-independent and justified by the empirical low-expression mode with a minimum-samples rule. Enrichment was not requested and the reference omits it; the plan adds a properly specified fgsea (full ranked list, moderated t, Hallmark/Reactome named, 15-500 window, BH, leading edge), so it is executed well but beyond scope. The report names the transform, method, versions, thresholds, counts, and n=6/6 caveats.
